Preserve the selected happy v2 anatomy: keep the warm eye-smile, visible tiny lower-lid and outer-corner smile creases, relaxed friendly brow arc, exact eye spacing, narrow apertures, compact blue-gray iris clusters, muted pale glints, and soft source palette. Keep the bottom cells' exact selected half-closed aperture, upper-lid coverage, and contours from the lower row; HALF must stay visibly half-closed and must not repeat OPEN. Do not widen the eyes or create broad white bands.
Keep the original face, hair, blue ornament, framing, registration, and pixel scale stable. Do not change the happy expression, brow/crease design, iris shape, iris width, or iris color. No large sclera, round/vector irises, bright new glints, white flashes, blur, gradients, extra subjects, text, or watermark.
